name: Bureau of Labor Statistics Public Data API
description: Access employment, price index, compensation, and other labor statistics data from the U.S. Bureau of Labor Statistics. Version 2 requires an API key and offers higher daily query limits, multiple series requests, calculations, and annual averages.
